1.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב
1.en: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

1.he: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה
1.en: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

1.he: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ
1.en: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

1.he: לֹא כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ
1.en: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

1.he: עַל כֵּ֤ן לֹא יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים
1.en: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

1.he: כִּֽי יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
1.en: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

2.he: לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ רִֽיק
2.en: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

2.he: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ מַלְכֵי אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ יָ֑חַד עַל יְ֝הוָה וְעַל מְשִׁיחֽוֹ
2.en: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

2.he: נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ
2.en: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

2.he: יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג לָֽמוֹ
2.en: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

2.he: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ
2.en: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

2.he: וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר קָדְשִֽׁי
2.en: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

2.he: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ
2.en: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

2.he: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
2.en: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

2.he: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם
2.en: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

2.he: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ
2.en: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

2.he: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה
2.en: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

2.he: נַשְּׁקוּ בַ֡ר פֶּן יֶאֱנַ֤ף וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ
2.en: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

3.he: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בָרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ
3.en: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

3.he: יְ֭הוָה מָֽה רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי
3.en: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”

3.he: רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֪ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵֽאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה
3.en: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

3.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗י וּמֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁי
3.en: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.

3.he: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּֽעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קָדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה
3.en: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.

3.he: אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי
3.en: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

3.he: לֹֽא אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי
3.en: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

3.he: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת כָּל אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ
3.en: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people.

3.he: לַיהוָ֥ה הַיְשׁוּעָ֑ה עַֽל עַמְּךָ֖ בִרְכָתֶ֣ךָ סֶּֽלָה

4.en: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

4.he: בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי
4.en: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?

4.he: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה
4.en: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

4.he: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו
4.en: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.

4.he: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה
4.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

4.he: זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝בִטְח֗וּ אֶל יְהוָֽה
4.en: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

4.he: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי יַרְאֵ֪נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה
4.en: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

4.he: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ
4.en: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

4.he: בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי

5.en: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.

5.he: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל
5.en: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

5.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה
5.en: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

5.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א אֵֽל חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע
5.en: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

5.he: לֹֽא יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
5.en: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

5.he: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב יְהוָֽה
5.en: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

5.he: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל הֵֽיכַל קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ
5.en: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

5.he: יְהוָ֤ה נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הושרהושרהַיְשַׁ֖רלְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ
5.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

5.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן
5.en: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

5.he: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ
5.en: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

5.he: וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ
5.en: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

5.he: כִּֽי אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ

6.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
6.en: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

6.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּאַפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וְֽאַל בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי
6.en: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

6.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי
6.en: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?

6.he: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד ואתואתוְאַתָּ֥היְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד מָתָֽי
6.en: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

6.he: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ
6.en: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

6.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה לָּֽךְ
6.en: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

6.he: יָגַ֤עְתִּי בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה
6.en: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

6.he: עָֽשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑י עָֽ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכָל צוֹרְרָֽי
6.en: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

6.he: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי
6.en: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

6.he: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח
6.en: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

6.he: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כָּל אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע

7.he: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל דִּבְרֵי כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן יְמִינִֽי
7.en: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

7.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי
7.en: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

7.he: פֶּן יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
7.en: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

7.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם יֶשׁ עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי
7.en: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),

7.he: אִם גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם
7.en: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust.

7.he: יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה
7.en: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

7.he: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ
7.en: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

7.he: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה
7.en: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

7.he: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי
7.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

7.he: יִגְמָר נָ֬א רַ֨ע רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק
7.en: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

7.he: מָֽגִנִּ֥י עַל אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
7.en: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

7.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל יֽוֹם
7.en: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

7.he: אִם לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ
7.en: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

7.he: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל
7.en: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

7.he: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר
7.en: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

7.he: בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל
7.en: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

7.he: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד
7.en: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.

7.he: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן

8.en: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

8.he: יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם
8.en: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

8.he: מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם
8.en: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;

8.he: כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה
8.en: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

8.he: מָֽה אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ
8.en: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

8.he: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ
8.en: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

8.he: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת רַגְלָֽיו
8.en: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

8.he: צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי
8.en: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

8.he: צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים
8.en: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

8.he: יְהוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָֽה אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ

9.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
9.en: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

9.he: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
9.en: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

9.he: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן
9.en: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

9.he: בְּשׁוּב אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ
9.en: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

9.he: כִּֽי עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק
9.en: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

9.he: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
9.en: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

9.he: הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה
9.en: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

9.he: וַֽ֭יהוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ
9.en: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

9.he: וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים
9.en: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

9.he: וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה
9.en: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

9.he: וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה
9.en: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

9.he: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו
9.en: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

9.he: כִּֽי דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת ענייםענייםעֲנָוִֽים
9.en: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

9.he: חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת
9.en: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

9.he: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
9.en: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

9.he: טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם
9.en: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.

9.he: נ֤וֹדַ֨ע יְהוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה
9.en: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

9.he: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כָּל גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
9.en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

9.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת ענויםענויםעֲ֝נִיִּ֗יםתֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד
9.en: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

9.he: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל פָּנֶֽיךָ
9.en: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men.

9.he: שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה

10.he: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה
10.en: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

10.he: בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ
10.en: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

10.he: כִּֽי הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ יְהוָֽה
10.en: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.

10.he: רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו
10.en: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

10.he: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דרכודרכודְרָכָ֨יו בְּכָל עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כָּל צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם
10.en: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

10.he: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא בְרָֽע
10.en: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

10.he: אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן
10.en: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

10.he: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ
10.en: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

10.he: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ
10.en: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

10.he: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח
10.en: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

10.he: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח ענייםענייםעֲנָוִֽים
10.en: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

10.he: עַל מֶ֤ה נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ
10.en: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”

10.he: רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר
10.en: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

10.he: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל תִּמְצָֽא
10.en: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

10.he: יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ
10.en: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

10.he: תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽךָ
10.en: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

10.he: לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ
10.en: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

11.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נודונודונ֝֗וּדִיהַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר
11.en: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

11.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
11.en: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

11.he: כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה פָּעָֽל
11.en: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

11.he: יְהוָ֤ה בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם
11.en: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

11.he: יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ
11.en: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

11.he: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם
11.en: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

11.he: כִּֽי צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ
11.en: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

12.en: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

12.he: הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הוָה כִּי גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
12.en: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

12.he: שָׁ֤וְא יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ
12.en: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

12.he: יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת
12.en: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

12.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ
12.en: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

12.he: מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֽוֹ
12.en: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

12.he: אִֽמֲר֣וֹת יְהוָה֮ אֲמָר֪וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם
12.en: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

12.he: אַתָּֽה יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ מִן הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם
12.en: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

12.he: סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם

13.en: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

13.he: עַד אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד אָ֓נָה תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי
13.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

13.he: עַד אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד אָ֓נָה יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי
13.en: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

13.he: הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת
13.en: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

13.he: פֶּן יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט
13.en: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

13.he: וַאֲנִ֤י בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַיהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי
13.en: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.

14.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה טֽוֹב
14.en: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

14.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל בְּנֵי אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
14.en: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

14.he: הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם אֶחָֽד
14.en: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

14.he: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
14.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

14.he: שָׁ֤ם פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק
14.en: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

14.he: עֲצַת עָנִ֥י תָבִ֑ישׁוּ כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסֵֽהוּ
14.en: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

14.he: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָֽאֵל
14.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

15.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי יָג֣וּר בְּאָהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
15.en: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

15.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָבֽוֹ
15.en: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

15.he: לֹֽא רָגַ֨ל עַל לְשֹׁנ֗וֹ לֹא עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא נָשָׂ֥א עַל קְרֹֽבוֹ
15.en: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

15.he: נִבְזֶ֤ה בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר
15.en: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

15.he: כַּסְפּ֤וֹ לֹא נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם
15.en: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

16.he: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ
16.en: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

16.he: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל עָלֶֽיךָ
16.en: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

16.he: לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל חֶפְצִי בָֽם
16.en: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

16.he: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל שְׂפָתָֽי
16.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

16.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי
16.en: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

16.he: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי
16.en: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

16.he: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי
16.en: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

16.he: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל אֶמּֽוֹט
16.en: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

16.he: לָכֵ֤ן שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח
16.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

16.he: כִּ֤י לֹא תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת
16.en: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

16.he: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח
16.en: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

17.he: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה
17.en: Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

17.he: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים
17.en: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

17.he: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל יַעֲבָר פִּֽי
17.en: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

17.he: לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ
17.en: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

17.he: תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑יךָ בַּל נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי
17.en: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

17.he: אֲנִֽי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי
17.en: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

17.he: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ
17.en: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

17.he: שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי
17.en: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

17.he: מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי
17.en: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

17.he: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סבבוניסבבוניסְבָב֑וּנוּעֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ
17.en: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

17.he: דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים
17.en: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

17.he: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ
17.en: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;

17.he: מִֽמְתִ֥ים יָדְךָ֨ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וצפינךוצפינךוּֽצְפוּנְךָ֮תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם
17.en: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

17.he: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ
17.en: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

18.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל
18.en: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

18.he: וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי
18.en: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

18.he: יְהוָ֤ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי
18.en: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

18.he: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ
18.en: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

18.he: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי
18.en: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

18.he: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
18.en: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

18.he: בַּצַּר לִ֤י אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו
18.en: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

18.he: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ
18.en: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

18.he: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ
18.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

18.he: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו
18.en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

18.he: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ
18.en: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

18.he: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים
18.en: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

18.he: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
18.en: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

18.he: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
18.en: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.

18.he: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם
18.en: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

18.he: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ
18.en: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

18.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
18.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

18.he: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
18.en: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

18.he: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי
18.en: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

18.he: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי
18.en: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

18.he: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי
18.en: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

18.he: כִּֽי שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי
18.en: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

18.he: כִּ֣י כָל מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי
18.en: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

18.he: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי
18.en: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

18.he: וַיָּֽשֶׁב יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו
18.en: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

18.he: עִם חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם
18.en: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

18.he: עִם נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל
18.en: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

18.he: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה עַם עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל
18.en: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

18.he: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי
18.en: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

18.he: כִּֽי בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר
18.en: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

18.he: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ
18.en: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

18.he: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
18.en: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

18.he: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי
18.en: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

18.he: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי
18.en: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

18.he: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי
18.en: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

18.he: וַתִּתֶּן לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי
18.en: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

18.he: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי
18.en: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

18.he: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא אָ֝שׁוּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם
18.en: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

18.he: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי
18.en: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

18.he: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי
18.en: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

18.he: וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם
18.en: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

18.he: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם
18.en: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

18.he: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל פְּנֵי ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם
18.en: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

18.he: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי
18.en: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

18.he: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ לִֽי
18.en: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

18.he: בְּנֵי נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם
18.en: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

18.he: חַי יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי
18.en: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

18.he: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי
18.en: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

18.he: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי
18.en: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

18.he: עַל כֵּ֤ן אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה
18.en: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

18.he: מגדלמגדלמַגְדִּיל֮יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם

19.en: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

19.he: הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד אֵ֑ל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗יו מַגִּ֥יד הָרָקִֽיעַ
19.en: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

19.he: י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה דָּֽעַת
19.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

19.he: אֵֽין אֹ֭מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם
19.en: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

19.he: בְּכָל הָאָ֨רֶץ יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם
19.en: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

19.he: וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח
19.en: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

19.he: מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵֽחַמָּתוֹ
19.en: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

19.he: תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי
19.en: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

19.he: פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם
19.en: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

19.he: יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
19.en: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

19.he: הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים
19.en: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

19.he: גַּֽם עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב
19.en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

19.he: גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל יִמְשְׁלוּ בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב
19.en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

19.he: יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן אִמְרֵי פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי

20.en: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

20.he: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב
20.en: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice.

20.he: יִזְכֹּ֥ר כָּל מִנְחֹתֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ֖ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה
20.en: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

20.he: יִֽתֶּן לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא
20.en: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

20.he: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ
20.en: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

20.he: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ
20.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

20.he: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר
20.en: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

20.he: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד
20.en: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!

20.he: יְהוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ

21.en: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

21.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּעָזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ מַה יגיליגיליָּ֥גֶלמְאֹֽד
21.en: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.

21.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה
21.en: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

21.he: כִּֽי תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז
21.en: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

21.he: חַיִּ֤ים שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
21.en: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

21.he: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו
21.en: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

21.he: כִּֽי תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת פָּנֶֽיךָ
21.en: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

21.he: כִּֽי הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
21.en: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

21.he: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ
21.en: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

21.he: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ
21.en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

21.he: פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
21.en: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

21.he: כִּי נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל יוּכָֽלוּ
21.en: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

21.he: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל פְּנֵיהֶֽם
21.en: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

21.he: ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ

22.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
22.en: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

22.he: אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי
22.en: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

22.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי
22.en: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

22.he: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
22.en: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

22.he: בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ
22.en: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

22.he: אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא בֽוֹשׁוּ
22.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

22.he: וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם
22.en: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

22.he: כָּל רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ
22.en: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

22.he: גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ
22.en: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

22.he: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי
22.en: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

22.he: עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה
22.en: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

22.he: אַל תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר
22.en: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

22.he: סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי
22.en: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

22.he: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג
22.en: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

22.he: כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי
22.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

22.he: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי
22.en: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

22.he: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי
22.en: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

22.he: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ בִֽי
22.en: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

22.he: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל
22.en: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

22.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה
22.en: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

22.he: הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי
22.en: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

22.he: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי
22.en: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

22.he: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ
22.en: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

22.he: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה הַֽלְל֗וּהוּ כָּל זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּהוּ וְג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ כָּל זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
22.en: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

22.he: כִּ֤י לֹֽא בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ
22.en: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

22.he: מֵ֥אִתְּךָ֗ תְֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥י בְּקָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽיו
22.en: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

22.he: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד
22.en: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

22.he: יִזְכְּר֤וּ וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם
22.en: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

22.he: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם
22.en: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

22.he: אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ כָּֽל דִּשְׁנֵי אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה
22.en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

22.he: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר
22.en: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

22.he: יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה

23.he: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר
23.en: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

23.he: בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי
23.en: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

23.he: נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ
23.en: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

23.he: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי
23.en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

23.he: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה
23.en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

23.he: אַ֤ךְ ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים
23.en: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

24.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ
24.en: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

24.he: כִּי ה֭וּא עַל יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑הּ וְעַל נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ
24.en: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

24.he: מִֽי יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְהַר יְהוָ֑ה וּמִי יָ֝קוּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ
24.en: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

24.he: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה
24.en: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

24.he: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ
24.en: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

24.he: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דרשודרשודֹּרְשָׁ֑יומְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
24.en: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob.

24.he: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד
24.en: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

24.he: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה
24.en: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.

24.he: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד
24.en: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

24.he: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה
24.en: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!

25.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא
25.en: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

25.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי
25.en: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

25.he: גַּ֣ם כָּל קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם
25.en: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

25.he: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי
25.en: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

25.he: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
25.en: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.

25.he: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה
25.en: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

25.he: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר לִי אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
25.en: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

25.he: טוֹב וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ
25.en: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

25.he: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ
25.en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

25.he: כָּל אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו
25.en: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

25.he: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב הֽוּא
25.en: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

25.he: מִי זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר
25.en: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

25.he: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ
25.en: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

25.he: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם
25.en: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

25.he: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי
25.en: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

25.he: פְּנֵה אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי
25.en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

25.he: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי
25.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

25.he: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל חַטֹּאותָֽי
25.en: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

25.he: רְאֵֽה אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי
25.en: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

25.he: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ
25.en: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

25.he: תֹּם וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ
25.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

25.he: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו
25.en: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.

26.he: לְדָוִ֨ד שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד
26.en: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

26.he: כִּֽי חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י וְ֝הִתְהַלַּ֗כְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ
26.en: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

26.he: לֹא יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא
26.en: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

26.he: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב
26.en: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

26.he: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
26.en: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,

26.he: לַ֭שְׁמִעַ בְּק֣וֹל תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ֝לְסַפֵּ֗ר כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
26.en: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

26.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
26.en: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

26.he: אַל תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי
26.en: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;

26.he: אֲשֶׁר בִּידֵיהֶ֥ם זִמָּ֑ה וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם מָ֣לְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד
26.en: in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

26.he: רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה
26.en: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

27.he: לְדָוִ֨ד יְהוָ֤ה אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד
27.en: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

27.he: בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ
27.en: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

27.he: אִם תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ
27.en: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

27.he: אַחַ֤ת שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית יְ֭הוָה כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ
27.en: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

27.he: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי
27.en: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

27.he: וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה
27.en: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.

27.he: שְׁמַע יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחָנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי
27.en: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

27.he: לְךָ֤ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ
27.en: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

27.he: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל תַּט בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי
27.en: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

27.he: כִּי אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽנִי
27.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

27.he: ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי
27.en: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

27.he: אַֽל תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ בִ֥י עֵֽדֵי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס
27.en: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

27.he: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים
27.en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

27.he: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְהוָֽה
27.en: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

28.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
28.en: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

28.he: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
28.en: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

28.he: אַל תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם
28.en: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

28.he: תֶּן לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם
28.en: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

28.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם
28.en: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

28.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי
28.en: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

28.he: יְהוָ֤ה עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ
28.en: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

28.he: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא
28.en: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

28.he: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה אֶת עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד הָעוֹלָֽם
28.en: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

29.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז
29.en: Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

29.he: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ
29.en: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

29.he: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
29.en: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

29.he: קוֹל יְהוָ֥ה בַּכֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הוָ֗ה בֶּהָדָֽר
29.en: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

29.he: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן
29.en: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

29.he: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן רְאֵמִֽים
29.en: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

29.he: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ
29.en: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

29.he: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד
29.en: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

29.he: יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם
29.en: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

29.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם
29.en: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

30.en: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

30.he: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹא שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי
30.en: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

30.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מיורדימיורדימִיָּֽרְדִי בֽוֹר
30.en: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

30.he: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ
30.en: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

30.he: כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה
30.en: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

30.he: וַ֭אֲנִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִ֑י בַּל אֶמּ֥וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם
30.en: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

30.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֪דְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִ֫י עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗יךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל
30.en: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:

30.he: אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וְאֶל אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן
30.en: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

30.he: מַה בֶּ֥צַע בְּדָמִי֮ בְּרִדְתִּ֪י אֶ֫ל שָׁ֥חַת הֲיוֹדְךָ֥ עָפָ֑ר הֲיַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ
30.en: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

30.he: שְׁמַע יְהוָ֥ה וְחָנֵּ֑נִי יְ֝הוָה הֱֽיֵה עֹזֵ֥ר לִֽי
30.en: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

30.he: הָפַ֣כְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי֮ לְמָח֪וֹל לִ֥י פִּתַּ֥חְתָּ שַׂקִּ֑י וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵ֥נִי שִׂמְחָֽה
30.en: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

30.he: לְמַ֤עַן יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעוֹלָ֥ם אוֹדֶֽךָּ

31.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
31.en: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

31.he: בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי
31.en: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

31.he: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י לְֽצוּר מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
31.en: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

31.he: כִּֽי סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי
31.en: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

31.he: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי
31.en: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

31.he: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת
31.en: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

31.he: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי
31.en: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

31.he: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי
31.en: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

31.he: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי
31.en: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

31.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי
31.en: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

31.he: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ
31.en: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

31.he: מִכָּל צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
31.en: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

31.he: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד
31.en: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

31.he: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ
31.en: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

31.he: וַאֲנִ֤י עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה
31.en: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

31.he: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי
31.en: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

31.he: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ
31.en: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

31.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל
31.en: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

31.he: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז
31.en: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

31.he: מָ֤ה רַֽב טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם
31.en: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

31.he: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת
31.en: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

31.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר
31.en: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

31.he: וַאֲנִ֤י אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ
31.en: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

31.he: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה
31.en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.

31.he: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה

32.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה
32.en: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

32.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּה
32.en: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

32.he: כִּֽי הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
32.en: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

32.he: כִּ֤י יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה
32.en: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.

32.he: חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה
32.en: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.

32.he: עַל זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל חָסִ֨יד אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ
32.en: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

32.he: אַתָּ֤ה סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה
32.en: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.

32.he: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי
32.en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

32.he: אַל תִּֽהְי֤וּ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶֽתֶג וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ
32.en: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

32.he: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ
32.en: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

32.he: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
32.en: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

33.he: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה
