33.en: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

33.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ לֽוֹ
33.en: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

33.he: שִֽׁירוּ ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה
33.en: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

33.he: כִּֽי יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה
33.en: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

33.he: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ
33.en: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

33.he: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל צְבָאָֽם
33.en: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

33.he: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת
33.en: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

33.he: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל
33.en: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

33.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד
33.en: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

33.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים
33.en: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

33.he: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר
33.en: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

33.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ
33.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

33.he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם
33.en: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

33.he: מִֽמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ
33.en: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

33.he: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם
33.en: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

33.he: אֵֽין הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב כֹּֽחַ
33.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

33.he: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט
33.en: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

33.he: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ
33.en: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

33.he: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב
33.en: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

33.he: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא
33.en: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

33.he: כִּי ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ
33.en: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

33.he: יְהִֽי חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ
33.en: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.

34.he: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ
34.en: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

34.he: אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי
34.en: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

34.he: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ
34.en: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

34.he: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו
34.en: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

34.he: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי
34.en: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

34.he: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל יֶחְפָּֽרוּ
34.en: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

34.he: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ
34.en: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

34.he: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם
34.en: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

34.he: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה בּֽוֹ
34.en: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

34.he: יְר֣אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו
34.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

34.he: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל טֽוֹב
34.en: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

34.he: לְֽכוּ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם
34.en: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

34.he: מִֽי הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב
34.en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

34.he: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה
34.en: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

34.he: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ
34.en: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

34.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל שַׁוְעָתָֽם
34.en: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

34.he: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם
34.en: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

34.he: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם
34.en: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

34.he: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת דַּכְּאֵי ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ
34.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

34.he: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה
34.en: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

34.he: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה
34.en: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

34.he: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ
34.en: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

34.he: פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ

35.he: לְדָוִ֨ד רִיבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת יְרִיבַ֑י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת לֹֽחֲמָֽי
35.en: Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

35.he: הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְצִנָּ֑ה וְ֝ק֗וּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי
35.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

35.he: וְהָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭סְגֹר לִקְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥ךְ אָֽנִי
35.en: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

35.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי
35.en: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

35.he: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה
35.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.

35.he: יְֽהִי דַרְכָּ֗ם חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּ֑וֹת וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽם
35.en: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.

35.he: כִּֽי חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ לִ֭י שַׁ֣חַת רִשְׁתָּ֑ם חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ לְנַפְשִֽׁי
35.en: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

35.he: תְּבוֹאֵ֣הוּ שׁוֹאָה֮ לֹֽא יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפָּל בָּֽהּ
35.en: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

35.he: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי תָּגִ֣יל בַּיהוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ
35.en: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

35.he: כָּ֥ל עַצְמוֹתַ֨י תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהוָ֗ה מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵחָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּזְלֽוֹ
35.en: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

35.he: יְ֭קוּמוּן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי
35.en: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

35.he: יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי
35.en: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

35.he: וַאֲנִ֤י בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י עַל חֵיקִ֥י תָשֽׁוּב
35.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

35.he: כְּרֵֽעַ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי
35.en: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

35.he: וּבְצַלְעִי֮ שָׂמְח֪וּ וְֽנֶאֱ֫סָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָֽרְע֥וּ וְלֹא דָֽמּוּ
35.en: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

35.he: בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣י שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ
35.en: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

35.he: אֲדֹנָי֮ כַּמָּ֪ה תִּ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽי
35.en: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

35.he: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ
35.en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

35.he: אַֽל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֣י אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ עָֽיִן
35.en: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

35.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן
35.en: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

35.he: וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽינוּ
35.en: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

35.he: רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הוָה אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֲל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי
35.en: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

35.he: הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַֽאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי
35.en: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

35.he: שָׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִֽי
35.en: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

35.he: אַל יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ
35.en: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

35.he: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי
35.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

35.he: יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֪י צִ֫דְקִ֥י וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ
35.en: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

35.he: וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ כָּל הַ֝יּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
35.en: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

36.en: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”

36.he: נְאֻֽם פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו
36.en: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

36.he: כִּֽי הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא
36.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

36.he: דִּבְרֵי פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב
36.en: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

36.he: אָ֤וֶן יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס
36.en: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

36.he: יְ֭הוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ עַד שְׁחָקִֽים
36.en: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

36.he: צִדְקָֽתְךָ֨ כְּֽהַרְרֵי אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָֽה
36.en: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

36.he: מַה יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן
36.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

36.he: יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם
36.en: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

36.he: כִּֽי עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה אֽוֹר
36.en: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

36.he: מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָֽתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
36.en: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

36.he: אַל תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְיַד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל תְּנִדֵֽנִי
36.en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

36.he: שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם

37.he: לְדָוִ֨ד אַל תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה
37.en: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

37.he: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן
37.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

37.he: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה
37.en: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

37.he: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ
37.en: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

37.he: גּ֣וֹל עַל יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה
37.en: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

37.he: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם
37.en: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

37.he: דּ֤וֹם לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת
37.en: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

37.he: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ לְהָרֵֽעַ
37.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

37.he: כִּֽי מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ אָֽרֶץ
37.en: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

37.he: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ
37.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

37.he: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם
37.en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

37.he: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו
37.en: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

37.he: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק ל֑וֹ כִּֽי רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ
37.en: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

37.he: חֶ֤רֶב פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי דָֽרֶךְ
37.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

37.he: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה
37.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

37.he: טוֹב מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
37.en: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

37.he: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה
37.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

37.he: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה
37.en: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

37.he: לֹֽא יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
37.en: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

37.he: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ
37.en: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

37.he: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן
37.en: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

37.he: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ
37.en: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

37.he: מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ
37.en: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

37.he: כִּֽי יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ
37.en: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

37.he: נַ֤עַר הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ לָֽחֶם
37.en: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

37.he: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה
37.en: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

37.he: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם
37.en: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

37.he: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת
37.en: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

37.he: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ
37.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

37.he: פִּֽי צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט
37.en: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

37.he: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו
37.en: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

37.he: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ
37.en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

37.he: יְ֭הוָה לֹא יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ
37.en: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

37.he: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל יְהוָ֨ה וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה
37.en: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

37.he: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן
37.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

37.he: וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא
37.en: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

37.he: שְׁמָר תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם
37.en: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

37.he: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה
37.en: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

37.he: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה
37.en: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

37.he: וַֽיַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ
37.en: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

38.he: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר
38.en: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

38.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי
38.en: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

38.he: כִּֽי חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ
38.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

38.he: אֵין מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי
38.en: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

38.he: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
38.en: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

38.he: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי
38.en: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

38.he: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי
38.en: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

38.he: כִּֽי כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי
38.en: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

38.he: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי
38.en: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

38.he: אֲֽדֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ֥ כָל תַּאֲוָתִ֑י וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא נִסְתָּֽרָה
38.en: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

38.he: לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר עֵינַ֥י גַּם הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי
38.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

38.he: אֹֽהֲבַ֨י וְרֵעַ֗י מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י מֵרָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ
38.en: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

38.he: וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ
38.en: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

38.he: וַאֲנִ֣י כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּֽיו
38.en: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

38.he: וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְאֵ֥ין בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת
38.en: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.

38.he: כִּֽי לְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי
38.en: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

38.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ
38.en: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

38.he: כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי לְצֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד
38.en: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

38.he: כִּֽי עֲוֺנִ֥י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי
38.en: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

38.he: וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר
38.en: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

38.he: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת רדופירדופירָֽדְפִי טֽוֹב
38.en: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.

38.he: אַל תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי
38.en: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

38.he: ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי

39.en: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

39.he: אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶֽשְׁמְרָ֣ה דְרָכַי֮ מֵחֲט֪וֹא בִלְשׁ֫וֹנִ֥י אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה לְפִ֥י מַחְס֑וֹם בְּעֹ֖ד רָשָׁ֣ע לְנֶגְדִּֽי
39.en: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

39.he: נֶאֱלַ֣מְתִּי ד֭וּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁ֣יתִי מִטּ֑וֹב וּכְאֵבִ֥י נֶעְכָּֽר
39.en: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

39.he: חַם לִבִּ֨י בְּקִרְבִּ֗י בַּהֲגִיגִ֥י תִבְעַר אֵ֑שׁ דִּ֝בַּ֗רְתִּי בִּלְשֽׁוֹנִי
39.en: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

39.he: הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי
39.en: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”

39.he: הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כָּֽל הֶ֥בֶל כָּל אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה
39.en: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

39.he: אַךְ בְּצֶ֤לֶם יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא יֵדַ֥ע מִי אֹסְפָֽם
39.en: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

39.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה מַה קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא
39.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

39.he: מִכָּל פְּשָׁעַ֥י הַצִּילֵ֑נִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל אַל תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי
39.en: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

39.he: נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ
39.en: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

39.he: הָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי
39.en: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”

39.he: בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל עָוֺ֨ן יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כָּל אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה
39.en: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

39.he: שִֽׁמְעָ֥ה תְפִלָּתִ֨י יְהוָ֡ה וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י הַאֲזִינָה֮ אֶֽל דִּמְעָתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכָל אֲבוֹתָֽי
39.en: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

39.he: הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶֽנִּי

40.en: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

40.he: קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי
40.en: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

40.he: וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֪יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי
40.en: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

40.he: וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֪ה לֵֽאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהוָֽה
40.en: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

40.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא פָנָ֥ה אֶל רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב
40.en: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

40.he: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִֽפְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר
40.en: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

40.he: זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה לֹֽא חָפַ֗צְתָּ אָ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ
40.en: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

40.he: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי
40.en: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

40.he: לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי
40.en: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

40.he: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ
40.en: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

40.he: צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹא כִסִּ֨יתִי בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב
40.en: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

40.he: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי
40.en: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

40.he: כִּ֤י אָפְפ֥וּ עָלַ֨י רָע֡וֹת עַד אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּֽׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי
40.en: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

40.he: רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה
40.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

40.he: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי
40.en: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

40.he: יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח
40.en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”

40.he: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אֹֽ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
40.en: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

40.he: וַאֲנִ֤י עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י יַחֲשָׁ֫ב לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל תְּאַחַֽר

41.en: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

41.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל דָּ֑ל בְּי֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥הוּ יְהוָֽה
41.en: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

41.he: יְהוָ֤ה יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִֽ֭יחַיֵּהוּ יאשריאשרוְאֻשַּׁ֣רבָּאָ֑רֶץ וְאַֽל תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗הוּ בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽיו
41.en: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

41.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶנּוּ עַל עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כָּל מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְחָלְיֽוֹ
41.en: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

41.he: אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נִי רְפָאָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י כִּי חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽךְ
41.en: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

41.he: אוֹיְבַ֗י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְאָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽוֹ
41.en: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

41.he: וְאִם בָּ֤א לִרְא֨וֹת שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗וֹ יִקְבָּץ אָ֥וֶן ל֑וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר
41.en: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

41.he: יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל שֹׂנְאָ֑י עָלַ֓י יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽי
41.en: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

41.he: דְּֽבַר בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא יוֹסִ֥יף לָקֽוּם
41.en: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

41.he: גַּם אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨י אֲשֶׁר בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣י עָקֵֽב
41.en: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

41.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה חָנֵּ֥נִי וַהֲקִימֵ֑נִי וַֽאֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָהֶֽם
41.en: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

41.he: בְּזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑י כִּ֤י לֹֽא יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי
41.en: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

41.he: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּ֭תֻמִּי תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑י וַתַּצִּיבֵ֖נִי לְפָנֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם
41.en: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

41.he: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵֽ֭הָעוֹלָם וְעַ֥ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן

42.en: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

42.he: כְּאַיָּ֗ל תַּעֲרֹ֥ג עַל אֲפִֽיקֵי מָ֑יִם כֵּ֤ן נַפְשִׁ֨י תַעֲרֹ֖ג אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִֽים
42.en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

42.he: צָמְאָ֬ה נַפְשִׁ֨י לֵאלֹהִים֮ לְאֵ֪ל חָ֥י מָתַ֥י אָב֑וֹא וְ֝אֵרָאֶ֗ה פְּנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים
42.en: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

42.he: הָֽיְתָה לִּ֬י דִמְעָתִ֣י לֶ֭חֶם יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה בֶּאֱמֹ֥ר אֵלַ֥י כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ
42.en: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

42.he: אֵ֤לֶּה אֶזְכְּרָ֨ה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָ֬ה עָלַ֨י נַפְשִׁ֗י כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱבֹ֨ר בַּסָּךְ֮ אֶדַּדֵּ֗ם עַד בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים בְּקוֹל רִנָּ֥ה וְתוֹדָ֗ה הָמ֥וֹן חוֹגֵֽג
42.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

42.he: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וַתֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֥וֹד אוֹדֶ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת פָּנָֽיו
42.en: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

42.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י עָלַי֮ נַפְשִׁ֪י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵהַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר
42.en: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

42.he: תְּהֽוֹם אֶל תְּה֣וֹם ק֭וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְ֝גַלֶּ֗יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ
42.en: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

42.he: יוֹמָ֤ם יְצַוֶּ֬ה יְהוָ֨ה חַסְדּ֗וֹ וּ֭בַלַּיְלָה שירהשירהשִׁיר֣וֹעִמִּ֑י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל חַיָּֽי
42.en: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

42.he: אוֹמְרָ֤ה לְאֵ֥ל סַלְעִי֮ לָמָ֪ה שְׁכַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה קֹדֵ֥ר אֵלֵ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב
42.en: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

42.he: בְּרֶ֤צַח בְּֽעַצְמוֹתַ֗י חֵרְפ֥וּנִי צוֹרְרָ֑י בְּאָמְרָ֥ם אֵלַ֥י כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ
42.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

42.he: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי

43.he: שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹא חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי
43.en: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

43.he: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָֽעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֪ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב
43.en: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

43.he: שְׁלַח אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל הַֽר קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ
43.en: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

43.he: וְאָב֤וֹאָה אֶל מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי
43.en: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

43.he: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי
43.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

44.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל
44.en: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

44.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם
44.en: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

44.he: אַתָּ֤ה יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם
44.en: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

44.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם
44.en: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!

44.he: אַתָּה ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב
44.en: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

44.he: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ
44.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

44.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
44.en: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

44.he: כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ
44.en: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever.

44.he: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁמְךָ֓ לְעוֹלָ֖ם נוֹדֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה
44.en: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

44.he: אַף זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ
44.en: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

44.he: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ
44.en: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

44.he: תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝בַגּוֹיִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ
44.en: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

44.he: תִּמְכֹּֽר עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא ה֑וֹן וְלֹ֥א רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם
44.en: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

44.he: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ
44.en: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

44.he: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
44.en: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

44.he: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי
44.en: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

44.he: מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם
44.en: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

44.he: כָּל זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ
44.en: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

44.he: לֹא נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ
44.en: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

44.he: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת
44.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

44.he: אִם שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר
44.en: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

44.he: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַֽחֲקָר זֹ֑את כִּֽי ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב
44.en: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

44.he: כִּֽי עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל הַיּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה
44.en: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

44.he: ע֤וּרָה לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח
44.en: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

44.he: לָֽמָּה פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ
44.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

44.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ
44.en: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

44.he: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ

45.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת
45.en: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

45.he: רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר
45.en: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

45.he: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל כֵּ֤ן בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם
45.en: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.

45.he: חֲגֽוֹר חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ
45.en: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

45.he: וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨ צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל דְּבַר אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה צֶ֑דֶק וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ
45.en: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

45.he: חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ
45.en: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

45.he: כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ
45.en: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

45.he: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א רֶ֥שַׁע עַל כֵּ֤ן מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵֽחֲבֵרֶֽיךָ
45.en: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

45.he: מֹר וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כָּל בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מִֽן הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ
45.en: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

45.he: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִֽ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר
45.en: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

45.he: שִׁמְעִי בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אָזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ וּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיךְ
45.en: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

45.he: וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי לֽוֹ
45.en: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

45.he: וּבַֽת צֹ֨ר בְּ֭מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם
45.en: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

45.he: כָּל כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ
45.en: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

45.he: לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֪ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ
45.en: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

45.he: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ
45.en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

45.he: תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑יךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ
45.en: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

45.he: אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹדֻ֗ךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד

46.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֑רַח עַֽל עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר
46.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

46.he: אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד
46.en: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

46.he: עַל כֵּ֣ן לֹא נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים
46.en: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling.

46.he: יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה
46.en: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

46.he: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן
46.en: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

46.he: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר
46.en: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

46.he: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ
46.en: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.

46.he: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
46.en: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.

46.he: לְֽכוּ חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ
46.en: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

46.he: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ
46.en: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

46.he: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ
46.en: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.

46.he: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה

47.en: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

47.he: כָּֽל הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה
47.en: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

47.he: כִּֽי יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝דוֹל עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
47.en: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

47.he: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ
47.en: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved.

47.he: יִבְחַר לָ֥נוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה
47.en: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

47.he: עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
47.en: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

47.he: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ
47.en: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

47.he: כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כָּל הָאָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל
47.en: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

47.he: מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב עַל כִּסֵּ֬א קָדְשֽׁוֹ
47.en: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

47.he: נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֪י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים מָֽגִנֵּי אֶ֗רֶץ מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה

48.en: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

48.he: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר קָדְשֽׁוֹ
48.en: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

48.he: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֪וֹשׂ כָּל הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב
48.en: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

48.he: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭מְּלָכִים נֽוֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
48.en: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

48.he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ
48.en: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever.

48.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה
48.en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

48.he: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל קַצְוֵי אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ
48.en: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

48.he: יִשְׂמַ֤ח הַר צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ
48.en: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

48.he: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן
48.en: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

48.he: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל מֽוּת

49.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר
49.en: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

49.he: שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֭את כָּל הָֽעַמִּ֑ים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינוּ כָּל יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד
49.en: both low and high, rich and poor together.

49.he: גַּם בְּנֵ֣י אָ֭דָם גַּם בְּנֵי אִ֑ישׁ יַ֝֗חַד עָשִׁ֥יר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן
49.en: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

49.he: פִּ֭י יְדַבֵּ֣ר חָכְמ֑וֹת וְהָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣י תְבוּנֽוֹת
49.en: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

49.he: אַטֶּ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֣ל אָזְנִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽי
49.en: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

49.he: לָ֣מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣י יְסוּבֵּֽנִי
49.en: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

49.he: הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עָ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ
49.en: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

49.he: אָ֗ח לֹא פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא יִתֵּ֖ן לֵאלֹהִ֣ים כָּפְרֽוֹ
49.en: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

49.he: וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם
49.en: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

49.he: וִֽיחִי ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת
49.en: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

49.he: כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם
49.en: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

49.he: קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר קָֽרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת
49.en: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

49.he: וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ
49.en: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings.

49.he: זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה
49.en: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

49.he: כַּצֹּ֤אן לִֽשְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥ם וַיִּרְדּ֘וּ בָ֤ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים לַבֹּ֗קֶר וצירםוצירםוְ֭צוּרָםלְבַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִזְּבֻ֥ל לֽוֹ
49.en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.

49.he: אַךְ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִפְדֶּ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִֽיַּד שְׁא֑וֹל כִּ֖י יִקָּחֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה
49.en: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

49.he: אַל תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּֽי יִ֝רְבֶּה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ
49.en: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

49.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ֭מוֹתוֹ יִקַּ֣ח הַכֹּ֑ל לֹא יֵרֵ֖ד אַחֲרָ֣יו כְּבוֹדֽוֹ
49.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

49.he: כִּֽי נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּ֣יו יְבָרֵ֑ךְ וְ֝יוֹדֻ֗ךָ כִּי תֵיטִ֥יב לָֽךְ
49.en: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

49.he: תָּ֭בוֹא עַד דּ֣וֹר אֲבוֹתָ֑יו עַד נֵ֝֗צַח לֹ֣א יִרְאוּ אֽוֹר
49.en: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

49.he: אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ

50.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד מְבֹאֽוֹ
50.en: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

50.he: מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ
50.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

50.he: יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽאַל יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ לְפָנָ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝סְבִיבָ֗יו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
50.en: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

50.he: יִקְרָ֣א אֶל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵעָ֑ל וְאֶל הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ לָדִ֥ין עַמּֽוֹ
50.en: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

50.he: אִסְפוּ לִ֥י חֲסִידָ֑י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי זָֽבַח
50.en: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

50.he: וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֓ים שֹׁפֵ֖ט ה֣וּא סֶֽלָה
50.en: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge.

50.he: שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ אָנֹֽכִי
50.en: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

50.he: לֹ֣א עַל זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד
50.en: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

50.he: לֹא אֶקַּ֣ח מִבֵּיתְךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗יךָ עַתּוּדִֽים
50.en: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

50.he: כִּי לִ֥י כָל חַיְתוֹ יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּהַרְרֵי אָֽלֶף
50.en: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

50.he: יָ֭דַעְתִּי כָּל ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽי
50.en: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

50.he: אִם אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא אֹ֣מַר לָ֑ךְ כִּי לִ֥י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ
50.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

50.he: הַֽ֭אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְדַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה
50.en: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

50.he: זְבַ֣ח לֵאלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְעֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ
50.en: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

50.he: וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי
50.en: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

50.he: וְלָ֤רָשָׁ֨ע אָ֘מַ֤ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים מַה לְּ֭ךָ לְסַפֵּ֣ר חֻקָּ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֖א בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי פִֽיךָ
50.en: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

50.he: וְ֭אַתָּה שָׂנֵ֣אתָ מוּסָ֑ר וַתַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ דְּבָרַ֣י אַחֲרֶֽיךָ
50.en: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

50.he: אִם רָאִ֣יתָ גַ֭נָּב וַתִּ֣רֶץ עִמּ֑וֹ וְעִ֖ם מְנָאֲפִ֣ים חֶלְקֶֽךָ
50.en: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

50.he: פִּ֭יךָ שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ בְרָעָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנְךָ֗ תַּצְמִ֥יד מִרְמָֽה
50.en: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

50.he: תֵּ֭שֵׁב בְּאָחִ֣יךָ תְדַבֵּ֑ר בְּבֶֽן אִ֝מְּךָ֗ תִּתֶּן דֹּֽפִי
50.en: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

50.he: אֵ֤לֶּה עָשִׂ֨יתָ וְֽהֶחֱרַ֗שְׁתִּי דִּמִּ֗יתָ הֱֽיוֹת אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה כָמ֑וֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ֖ וְאֶֽעֶרְכָ֣ה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ
50.en: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

50.he: בִּֽינוּ נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
50.en: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

50.he: זֹבֵ֥חַ תּוֹדָ֗ה יְֽכַ֫בְּדָ֥נְנִי וְשָׂ֥ם דֶּ֑רֶךְ אַ֝רְאֶ֗נּוּ בְּיֵ֣שַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים
50.en: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

51.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
51.en: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

51.he: בְּֽבוֹא אֵ֭לָיו נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא כַּֽאֲשֶׁר בָּ֝֗א אֶל בַּת שָֽׁבַע
51.en: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

51.he: חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי
51.en: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

51.he: הרבההרבההֶ֭רֶבכַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי
51.en: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

51.he: כִּֽי פְ֭שָׁעַי אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְחַטָּאתִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד
51.en: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

51.he: לְךָ֤ לְבַדְּךָ֨ חָטָאתִי֮ וְהָרַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּדָבְרֶ֗ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְשָׁפְטֶֽךָ
51.en: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

51.he: הֵן בְּעָו֥וֹן חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי וּ֝בְחֵ֗טְא יֶֽחֱמַ֥תְנִי אִמִּֽי
51.en: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

51.he: הֵן אֱ֭מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַטֻּח֑וֹת וּ֝בְסָתֻ֗ם חָכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי
51.en: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

51.he: תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין
51.en: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

51.he: תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ
51.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

51.he: הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י וְֽכָל עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣י מְחֵֽה
51.en: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

51.he: לֵ֣ב טָ֭הוֹר בְּרָא לִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ נָ֝כ֗וֹן חַדֵּ֥שׁ בְּקִרְבִּֽי
51.en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

51.he: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥נִי מִלְּפָנֶ֑יךָ וְר֥וּחַ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ אַל תִּקַּ֥ח מִמֶּֽנִּי
51.en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

51.he: הָשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֭י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וְר֖וּחַ נְדִיבָ֣ה תִסְמְכֵֽנִי
51.en: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

51.he: אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים אֵלֶ֥יךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ
51.en: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

51.he: הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִדָּמִ֨ים אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְּשׁוּעָתִ֑י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י צִדְקָתֶֽךָ
51.en: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

51.he: אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
51.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

51.he: כִּ֤י לֹא תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶתֵּ֑נָה ע֝וֹלָ֗ה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה
51.en: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

51.he: זִֽבְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ ר֪וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה לֵב נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה
51.en: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

51.he: הֵיטִ֣יבָה בִ֭רְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּ֑וֹן תִּ֝בְנֶ֗ה חוֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
אָ֤ז תַּחְפֹּ֣ץ זִבְחֵי צֶ֭דֶק עוֹלָ֣ה וְכָלִ֑יל אָ֤ז יַעֲל֖וּ עַל מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ פָרִֽים

52.en: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

52.he: בְּב֤וֹא דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִי֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ד לְשָׁ֫א֥וּל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑וֹ בָּ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד אֶל בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ
52.en: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

52.he: מַה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭רָעָה הַגִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
52.en: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth.

52.he: הַ֭וּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב לְשׁוֹנֶ֑ךָ כְּתַ֥עַר מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה
52.en: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

52.he: אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִטּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר מִדַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה
52.en: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living.

52.he: אָהַ֥בְתָּ כָֽל דִּבְרֵי בָ֗לַע לְשׁ֣וֹן מִרְמָֽה
52.en: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

52.he: גַּם אֵל֮ יִתָּצְךָ֪ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵֽׁרֶשְׁךָ֨ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה
52.en: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

52.he: הִנֵּ֤ה הַגֶּ֗בֶר לֹ֤א יָשִׂ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָֽע֫וּזּ֥וֹ וַ֭יִּבְטַח בְּרֹ֣ב עָשְׁר֑וֹ יָ֝עֹ֗ז בְּהַוָּתֽוֹ
52.en: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

52.he: וַאֲנִ֤י כְּזַ֣יִת רַ֭עֲנָן בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּטַ֥חְתִּי בְחֶֽסֶד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
אוֹדְךָ֣ לְ֭עוֹלָם כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַאֲקַוֶּ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֥ כִֽי ט֝֗וֹב נֶ֣גֶד חֲסִידֶֽיךָ

53.en: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

53.he: אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְהִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה טֽוֹב
53.en: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

53.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
53.en: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

53.he: כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם אֶחָֽד
53.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

53.he: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
53.en: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

53.he: שָׁ֤ם פָּֽחֲדוּ פַחַד֮ לֹא הָ֪יָה֫ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם
53.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

53.he: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשֻׁע֪וֹת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

54.en: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

54.he: בְּב֣וֹא הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ
54.en: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.

54.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי
54.en: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

54.he: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה
54.en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

54.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי
54.en: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

54.he: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי טֽוֹב
כִּ֣י מִכָּל צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי

55.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד
55.en: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

55.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְאַל תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי
55.en: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

55.he: הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה
55.en: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

55.he: מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִפְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥י אָ֝֗וֶן וּבְאַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי
55.en: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

55.he: לִ֭בִּי יָחִ֣יל בְּקִרְבִּ֑י וְאֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי
55.en: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

55.he: יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑י וַ֝תְּכַסֵּ֗נִי פַּלָּצֽוּת
55.en: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

55.he: וָאֹמַ֗ר מִֽי יִתֶּן לִּ֣י אֵ֭בֶר כַּיּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה
55.en: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.”

55.he: הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד אָלִ֖ין בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר סֶֽלָה
55.en: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

55.he: אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑י מֵר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִסָּֽעַר
55.en: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

55.he: בַּלַּ֣ע אֲ֭דֹנָי פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כִּֽי רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְרִ֣יב בָּעִֽיר
55.en: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

55.he: יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥הָ עַל חוֹמֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאָ֖וֶן וְעָמָ֣ל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ
55.en: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

55.he: הַוּ֥וֹת בְּקִרְבָּ֑הּ וְֽלֹא יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝רְחֹבָ֗הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּמִרְמָֽה
55.en: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

55.he: כִּ֤י לֹֽא אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗נִי וְאֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹֽא מְ֭שַׂנְאִי עָלַ֣י הִגְדִּ֑יל וְאֶסָּתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽנּוּ
55.en: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

55.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּֽעִי
55.en: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

55.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ
55.en: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

55.he: ישימותישימותיַשִּׁ֤י מָ֨וֶת עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי רָע֖וֹת בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם בְּקִרְבָּֽם
55.en: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

55.he: אֲ֭נִי אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝יהוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
55.en: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

55.he: עֶ֤רֶב וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי
55.en: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

55.he: פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְשָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב לִ֑י כִּֽי בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי
55.en: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. They never change, who don’t fear God.

55.he: יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֵ֨ל וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים
55.en: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

55.he: שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ
55.en: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

55.he: חָלְק֤וּ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקֲרָב לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת
55.en: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

55.he: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל יְהוָ֨ה יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק
55.en: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

55.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח בָּֽךְ

56.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ עַל י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּֽאֱחֹ֨ז אֹת֖וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּגַֽת
56.en: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

56.he: חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי שְׁאָפַ֣נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי
56.en: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

56.he: שָׁאֲפ֣וּ שׁ֭וֹרְרַי כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם כִּֽי רַבִּ֨ים לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣י מָרֽוֹם
56.en: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

56.he: בֵּאלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֪ל דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽי
56.en: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

56.he: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖י כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם לָרָֽע
56.en: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

56.he: יָג֤וּרוּ יצפינויצפינויִצְפּ֗וֹנוּהֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי
56.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

56.he: עַל אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים
56.en: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

56.he: נֹדִי֮ סָפַ֪רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ
56.en: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

56.he: אָ֥֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶה יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי
56.en: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

56.he: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝יהוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר
56.en: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

56.he: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽי
56.en: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

56.he: עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑יךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ
56.en: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

56.he: כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַֽחַיִּֽים

57.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבָרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה
57.en: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

57.he: חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת
57.en: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

57.he: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי
57.en: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

57.he: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ
57.en: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

57.he: נַפְשִׁ֤י בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה
57.en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

57.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
57.en: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves.

57.he: רֶ֤שֶׁת הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִפְעָמַי֮ כָּפַ֪ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּר֣וּ לְפָנַ֣י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְתוֹכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה
57.en: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

57.he: נָ֘כ֤וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֑י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה
57.en: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

57.he: ע֤וּרָה כְבוֹדִ֗י ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר
57.en: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

57.he: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֑י אֲ֝זַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
57.en: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

57.he: כִּֽי גָדֹ֣ל עַד שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ
57.en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

57.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ

58.en: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

58.he: הַֽאֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם
58.en: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

58.he: אַף בְּלֵב֮ עוֹלֹ֪ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן בָּאָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּן
58.en: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

58.he: זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵרָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב
58.en: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

58.he: חֲמַת לָ֗מוֹ כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽוֹ
58.en: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

58.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יִ֭שְׁמַע לְק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם
58.en: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

58.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס שִׁנֵּ֥ימוֹ בְּפִ֑ימוֹ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ יְהוָֽה
58.en: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

58.he: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ לָ֑מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חצוחצוחִ֝צָּ֗יוכְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ
58.en: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

58.he: כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ
58.en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

58.he: בְּטֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמוֹ חַ֥י כְּמוֹ חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ
58.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

58.he: יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע
58.en: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

58.he: וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ

59.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ
59.en: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

59.he: הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
59.en: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

59.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָֽרְב֡וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣י עַזִ֑ים לֹא פִשְׁעִ֖י וְלֹא חַטָּאתִ֣י יְהוָֽה
59.en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

59.he: בְּֽלִי עָ֭וֺן יְרוּצ֣וּן וְיִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵה
59.en: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors.

59.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהִ֥ים צְבָא֡וֹת אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָה לִפְקֹ֥ד כָּֽל הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַל תָּחֹ֨ן כָּל בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה
59.en: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

59.he: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר
59.en: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

59.he: הִנֵּ֤ה יַבִּ֘יע֤וּן בְּפִיהֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ
59.en: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

59.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׂחַק לָ֑מוֹ תִּ֝לְעַ֗ג לְכָל גּוֹיִֽם
59.en: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

59.he: עֻ֭זּוֹ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑רָה כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי
59.en: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
